author: Greta
content: The cellar door creaks open. Bram — your move.

author: Greta
content: No trap you can see — old hinges, older dust. What do you do?

author: Greta
content: 17 slips you through the gap without a sound. Mira — you're up.

author: Mira
content: I follow him in, dagger out.

author: Greta
content: You both stand in the dark of the cellar. Session paused here.
